title: conioselinum bipinnatum
intro: Conioselinum bipinnatum, commonly known as King Devil, is a flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. The health benefits of Conioselinum bipinnatum include its use as a natural remedy for respiratory issues, such as colds and bronchitis, due to its expectorant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate sweating, promote urination, and relieve spasms, making it a potential treatment for fever and rheumatism. Conioselinum bipinnatum contains bioactive constituents, including volatile oils, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
